summary: Iteration 15 regression: CSV template download, bulk-delete drafts, and BotW auto-rotation (weekly hybrid with 24h veto window). 14/14 backend pytest tests pass and 16/16 iter14 CSV regression tests still pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end (template download, select-all/deselect-all, per-draft checkbox, bulk-delete, admin BotW panel controls, cross-role leak). Found and FIXED one critical bug: GET /api/admin/botw/queue returned 500 due to naive vs tz-aware datetime comparison in the eligible_brands sort key (three call sites in routes/botw.py). Backend now stable end-to-end.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider a data-migration one-off that normalises any legacy `brands.botw_last_featured_at` naive datetimes to tz-aware UTC, so the tz-normalisation defensive code in routes/botw.py can eventually be simplified.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: routes/botw.py had 3 sites (_pick_next_brand fair-rotation sort, performance-week scoring, and admin_botw_queue sort) that assumed botw_last_featured_at was always tz-aware. Legacy brand docs from the manual BotW endpoint store naive datetimes, so sorting the mixed list crashed with 'can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. All three sites now normalise via replace(tzinfo=utc) when tzinfo is None.

routes/botw.py:_score_brand_performance iterates orders row-by-row in Python instead of using an aggregation pipeline. Fine for MVP volumes; flag if the orders collection grows past ~10k/month per brand.
routes/botw.py history is capped at 20 rotations; that's ~5 months of data — reasonable for MVP but worth noting for future reporting/audit needs.
ImportProducts.js CSV_TEMPLATE constant duplicates the backend Shopify column convention; consider serving the template from a backend endpoint so aliases stay in sync (currently drift risk).
AdminBotwRotationPanel handleVeto/handleSkip/handleRotateNow share almost identical try/finally scaffolding — could be extracted into a small useAsyncAction hook but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of visible flows exercised (template download, bulk-delete, BotW panel controls, cross-role leak)

seed_data_creation: test_iter15_botw_and_bulk_delete.py creates a handful of TEST_iter15_* draft products via CSV import solely to exercise bulk-delete, then deletes them within the same test. No residue expected. UI test also created + deleted 2 seed drafts named TEST_UI_DraftAlpha/Beta. BotW state was rotated once by pytest and once by the UI test; whichever brand ended up current is fine (repeated tests are idempotent because rotate-now uses the queued next or auto-picks).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter15 introduced three features: CSV template download button, bulk-delete for drafts, BotW auto-rotation. The one bug found was a naive-vs-aware datetime crash in /api/admin/botw/queue when legacy brands existed with naive botw_last_featured_at. Fixed defensively at 3 sites in routes/botw.py. Full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_botw_and_bulk_delete.py covers auth gates, all 4 admin endpoints, bulk-delete happy/edge paths.
rca of the issue: GET /api/admin/botw/queue crashed with `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes` when at least one brand had a legacy naive `botw_last_featured_at` (from the manual set-brand-of-week endpoint) and another had a tz-aware value (from the new rotate-now flow). The sort in _list_eligible_brands and in admin_botw_queue tried to compare them and raised. REPRO: manual set-BotW on brand A (writes naive datetime pre-fix), rotate-now once (writes tz-aware datetime on brand B), then GET /api/admin/botw/queue → 500. MITIGATION: normalise naive datetimes to UTC in the sort key at 3 sites in routes/botw.py — done in this iteration.
